name: Unbound Inferno blasts only enemies carrying the Flames of Xoroth debuff (#347)
contract: Flames of Xoroth is not only frontal damage: every rank (801059, 802411-802415, 573448) has effect 1 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA 271 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER, BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0%) on the same TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24 targets as its damage, DurationIndex 8 (15 s), no SPELL_ATTR0_DO_NOT_DISPLAY and the aura tooltip 'Seared by infernal flames.'; its own description adds '@ifknown:704997:Infernal Strike blasts nearby enemies affected by this for bonus Fire damage.'. Unbound Inferno 704997 reads 'Your Infernal Strikes against enemies affected by your [Hellmaw or] Flames of Xoroth now blasts nearby enemies' for 801037 Fire damage, so the 15 s debuff is the mark. At level 35 the owned ranks are Infernal Strike 501514 and Flames of Xoroth 802413 (spell_ranks chains them to 801016/801059). An Infernal Strike on an unmarked enemy blasts nothing; after Flames of Xoroth the same enemy carries the knight's harmful 801059-family aura and the next Infernal Strike blasts it and a neighbour 3 yd away.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Force the Unbound Inferno passive aura
Infernal Strike requires a main-hand weapon
SETUP: the Unbound Inferno passive is active
Infernal Strike on an enemy without the Flames of Xoroth debuff
SETUP: Infernal Strike hit the enemy
Let any triggered blast land
CONTRACT: no debuff, no Unbound Inferno blast
Clear the global cooldown
Flames of Xoroth requires Demonfire (CasterAuraSpell 500906)
Flames of Xoroth on both enemies in front
SETUP: Flames of Xoroth hit the enemy
CONTRACT: Flames of Xoroth leaves its own aura on the enemy it burned
CONTRACT: that aura is a debuff
CONTRACT: the debuff lasts 15 s
Clear the global cooldown
Infernal Strike on the debuffed enemy
SETUP: the second Infernal Strike hit
CONTRACT: Unbound Inferno blasts the debuffed enemy
CONTRACT: the blast also hits the nearby enemy
